row.evidence: ChatGPT's pricing page lists SCIM under Enterprise ('Enterprise-level security and controls, including SCIM, EKM, ...', Contact sales) while Business offers SAML SSO; OpenAI's help centre says 'A standalone ChatGPT Business plan and ChatGPT for Teachers do not include SCIM.'
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Business still $20/u/mo annual (2+ users), $25 monthly; SAML/OIDC SSO is included with Business; SCIM is Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare only (Contact Sales). June's '~150-seat minimum, est. $60+/u/mo' had no first-party source and is dropped. SCIM can be workspace-level or tenant-wide (Admin Console), and also covers API Platform organizations on Custom/Unlimited billing. Deprovisioning removes workspace membership but not the OpenAI account; no public SCIM base URL or attribute list. A ChatGPT Admin API (api.chatgpt.com/v1, Enterprise admin keys) lists, updates and removes workspace members and manages invitations and manual groups; SCIM-managed members must be removed through the IdP. The Okta 'OpenAI' catalogue entry is a Workflows connector, not an SSO/SCIM app; IdP catalogue entries for the ChatGPT app were not confirmed. Vendor renamed for the row as 'ChatGPT (OpenAI)'.

plans.name: Go
plans.notes: Individual plan; pricing table marks SAML SSO and SCIM as No.

plans.name: Business
plans.price_text: $20 / user / month (2+ users, billed annually); $25 billed monthly
plans.notes: $20 annual and $25 monthly prices are shown on the pricing page's Business & Enterprise tab (read via a headless tab click); the page HTML holds them as template variables, so only the 2+ users line is quotable from a plain load.

scim.notes: Also available for ChatGPT Edu and Healthcare workspaces, Ads accounts (tenant-wide), and API Platform organizations on Custom or Unlimited billing. Connection values are shown only in the admin UI.

auth.token_source: Workspace settings > Identity & access > Directory Sync (SCIM), or Admin Console > Global settings > Access > Directory (tenant-wide)

deprovision.data_retained: The OpenAI account and personal workspace are not deleted; workspace data retention follows the workspace's policy.

roles.how: Synchronized groups get the Member role on invite; workspace owners assign custom roles to synchronized groups in Permissions & roles. Product access does not assign the owner role.

limitations.text: Tenant-wide SCIM cannot change the email address on an existing OpenAI account.
Users added by automatic account creation may not be SCIM-managed and may keep access after IdP removal.
SCIM-managed invitations cannot be resent directly.
Removing a member only inside ChatGPT is undone by the next sync if the IdP still assigns them.
SCIM-provisioned users inherit the workspace default seat type.

user_api.notes: ChatGPT Admin API (Enterprise workspaces, workspace-scoped admin keys). The separate OpenAI API Platform has its own organization admin endpoints, not researched here.

scopes: Custom, Read only or All permissions (Users read/write and others)

capabilities.notes: delete_user removes workspace membership only; assign_licenses = product seat via Update Workspace User.

limitations.text: SCIM-managed members, invitations and groups must be managed through the IdP; the API returns 409 scim_managed_resource.

entra.notes: OpenAI names Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, PingFederate, OneLogin and Rippling as supported; IdP catalogue pages not confirmed.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/openai/ is a Workflows connector only (no SAML/SCIM checked); a ChatGPT SSO/SCIM OIN entry was not found.

fallbacks.notes: Automatic account creation adds users who sign in with a verified-domain email; it does not require SSO.
